MODULES.description: Module selection strategy: most, netboot, dep, or list.

BUSYBOX.description: Use busybox shell/utilities: y, n, or auto.

KEYMAP.description: Load keymap during initramfs: y or n.

COMPRESS.description: Compression algorithm: gzip, bzip2, lz4, lzma, lzop, xz, or zstd.

COMPRESSLEVEL.description: Compression level for the compressor. Defaults vary by compressor. Leave empty to use defaults.

DEVICE.description: Specific network interface to use (e.g., eth0). Leave empty for automatic detection.

NFSROOT.description: NFS root configuration: auto or HOST:MOUNT.

RUNSIZE.description: Size of the /run tmpfs mount point (e.g., 256M or 10%).

FSTYPE.description: Filesystem type(s) to support, or 'auto' to use the current root filesystem type.
